summary: THE CLAIM IS FIXED AT SOURCE AND THE GUARD IS IN PLACE (resolves the failure entry of the same date). ce-parts/microduck-foot-left and -right cad/interfaces.json 'roller_slot' rows now state the measured capture — the ankle's 36.5000 mm plate in the 36.7000 mm pocket at 0.1000 mm per side, barb land 34.7000 mm over z -13.4000..-14.0000, 0.9000 mm of deflection per finger — and name the refutation instead of the roller. part:microduck-ankle-left and -right gained the matching 'foot_snap_plate' interface, measured. compat.py's `captures_what` check FAILs any row that reasserts the roller and PASSes the corrected one; mate() refuses a plate that clears the barbs (nothing captured) and a plate wider than the pocket. All verified live 2026-09-02 by `python3 compat.py` and `python3 cad/mate.py`.

THE SNAP FORCES ARE MISSING AND WILL NOT BE COMPUTED. Each finger must deflect 0.9000 mm for the plate to pass; the finger run is 10.0000 mm and the lead-in half angle 33.47 deg — all measured. Turning that into newtons needs the printed PLA's modulus and permissible strain AT THIS LAYER ORIENTATION, and neither is in any file in this repo. The published cantilever snap-fit guidance (BASF / Bayer handbooks) is a formula, not a material property: fed a guessed modulus it produces a number with a citation and no source, which is worse than an honest absence. So compat.py refuses insertion_force and retention_force by name and mate() states the refusal in why.force. What settles it: push a printed pair home on a gauge and record the peak, pull it off and record that, then state insertion_N and retention_N on the finger interface.

THE FOLDER WORKS THROUGH THE ONE INTEGRATION SEAM, not just when run directly. cecad.triad.mate("connection:snap-fit-roller-axle", a_iface, b_iface, params) — TRIAD.md's single seam, the call every other app (ce-struct, ce-pcb, ce-wire, the APIs) reaches this folder through — was invoked live on the reference interface pair on 2026-09-02 and mate() returned dof_left [], adds [], holds_by 'form' for the home state, and dof_left ['translation_along_z'] for params state 'passing' — the assembly move. Run in FreeCAD's python 3.11 with CE_TRIAD_ROOT set to this repo plus ce-workshop. All four connection folders authored in this lane were exercised the same way in the same run and all four returned; none raised.
by: claude (microduck lane T), cecad.triad.mate through the loader
